name: Bear Beans Café
source:
Broke, burnt out, and new in town, Theo Bennet walks into a struggling little café and walks out with a job he’s wildly unqualified for.
One viral photo later, Bear Beans is packed — and staffed by four enormous men who each have their own reasons for being there.
But success attracts attention, and a certain consultant has plans for the place that don’t include Jae.
Save the café. Try not to fall for everyone in it.
